sql: SELECT coalesce(p.series_ticker,'-') AS series, count(*)::text AS markets, round(sum(p.period_reward_usd),2)::text AS reward_sum_usd, min(p.period_reward_usd)::text AS per_market, min(p.target_size)::text AS tgt, min(p.discount_factor_bps)::text AS disc, min(p.start_date)::text AS starts, max(p.end_date)::text AS ends FROM incentive_programs p WHERE p.superseded_at IS NULL AND p.disappeared_at IS NULL AND p.incentive_type='liquidity' AND p.series_ticker IN ('KXFEATURE','KXMLBPLAYOFFS','KXREDROCKS','KXBOSTONCALLING','KXWAAEROEMP','KXHALFTIME','KXSBHALFTIME') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(p.period_reward_usd) DESC LIMIT 12
